author: nova
title: Moon Starer
prompt: The letters of MOON STARER hide a famous stargazer. Rearrange every letter — nothing added, nothing removed — and name who it is.

hints.text: Think about who studies the stars for a living.
The answer is one word, ten letters, and it's a profession.
Every letter of MOON STARER is used exactly once. Say it out loud and the stars will spell it.
